What is Alzheimer’s?

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.17.4″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”Archivo||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”16px” text_font_size_tablet=”16px” text_font_size_phone=”14px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” global_colors_info=”{}”]

The most frequent form of dementia is Alzheimer’s disease. It’s a progressive condition that starts with mild memory loss and progresses to the loss of the ability to converse and respond to the environment. Parts of the brain that control thought, memory, and language are affected by Alzheimer’s disease. It can have a significant impact on a person’s capacity to carry out daily tasks.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure=”1_2,1_2″ _builder_version=”4.17.4″ _module_preset=”default” custom_margin=”-54px|auto||auto||” custom_padding=”||0px|||” global_colors_info=”{}” width__hover_enabled=”off|desktop”][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.17.4″ _module_preset=”default” header_2_font=”Baskervville||||||||” header_2_text_color=”#133F75″ header_2_font_size=”3vw” header_2_line_height=”1.1em” custom_margin=”||16px||false|false” header_2_font_size_tablet=”32px” header_2_font_size_phone=”8vw” header_2_font_size_last_edited=”on|desktop” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Signs & Symptoms

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.17.4″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”Archivo||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”16px” text_font_size_tablet=”16px” text_font_size_phone=”14px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” global_colors_info=”{}”]

  • Memory Problems
  • Memory loss that disrupts daily life, such as getting lost in a familiar place or repeating questions.
  • Trouble handling money and paying bills.
  • Difficulty completing familiar tasks at home, at work, or at leisure.
  • Decreased or poor judgment.
  • Misplacing things and being unable to retrace steps to find them.
  • Changes in mood, personality, or behavior.
